examples.text: Gegen Windmühlenflügel zu kämpfen ist sinnlos.
examples.translation: Se battre contre des moulins est absurde.

examples.text: Viele junge Männer hatten schlicht Angst, eingezogen zu werden und in einem Krieg zu kämpfen, den sie barbarisch und sinnlos finden.
examples.translation: De nombreux jeunes hommes avaient tout simplement peur d’être appelés au service militaire et de combattre dans une guerre qu’ils trouvaient barbare et insensée.

glosses: ohne Sinn seiend, eine inhaltsleere oder unüberlegte Aussage seiend, ohne Zusammenhang seiend, sich auf fehlenden Sinn beziehend, ohne Zweck, ohne Vernunft seiend

examples.text: Jede sinnlose Aussage ist sinnfrei. Nicht jede sinnfreie Aussage ist jedoch sinnlos. Denn sowohl „sinnfrei“ als auch „sinnlos“ bedeutet ‚ohne Sinn‘.

glosses: Without feeling or desire to work; deprived of sensation.

examples.text: The blow to his head rendered him senseless; he didn’t awaken until he was in the ambulance.
That hoary man had spent his livelong age / In converse with the dead, who leave the stamp / Of ever-burning thoughts on many a page, / When they are gone into the senseless damp / Of graves; […]

glosses: Lacking meaning or purpose; without common sense.

examples.text: What a senseless waste of money.

glosses: Without a discernible meaning or purpose, especially of a violent or evil act.

examples.text: The school shooting was a senseless act of violence.
Addressing the nation on Thursday, Czech Prime Minister Petr Fiala called the shooting “a senseless attack” and said “this Christmas will be unimaginably sad.”
At the news conference, Crump called her killing “senseless on every level.”

glosses: Without consideration, awareness or sound judgement

examples.text: He took senseless risks, not even aware of the danger he was in.

glosses: Contrary to reason or propriety; obviously and flatly opposed to manifest truth; inconsistent with the plain dictates of common sense; logically contradictory; nonsensical; ridiculous; silly.

examples.text: This proffer is absurd and reasonless.
'Tis phrase absurd to call a villain great

glosses: Having no rational or orderly relationship to people's lives; meaningless; lacking order or value.

examples.text: Adults have condemned them to live in what must seem like an absurd universe.

glosses: The opposition between the human search for meaning in life and the inability to find any; the state or condition in which man exists in an irrational universe and his life has no meaning outside of his existence.
Insensé ; contraire au bon sens ou au sens commun.

examples.text: Le règne de l’absurde crinoline venait de finir et une robe bien coupée mettait en relief tous les avantages naturels de la dame […].
Chaque épisode est une suite de gags absurdes, de situations grand-guignolesques, d’humour ironique.

Ton père est mort, d’une mort bête. Toutes les morts sont absurdes, d’ailleurs.

glosses: Qualifie une personne qui parle ou agit de manière absurde.

examples.text: Un raisonneur absurde.
Vous êtes absurde.

glosses: Chose qui dépasse l’entendement, fausse et inacceptable par la raison.

examples.text:

glosses: Opuesto a la razón y al sentido común.
Que no actúa de acuerdo a un pensamiento lógico o normal, que se aparta de la razón.
Dicho o hecho que repugna a la razón.
Aquello que no es útil, no sirve o no cumple su función.

examples.text: Al terminar el gas el mechero ha quedado inútil.

glosses: Incapacitado para realizar labores o movimientos a causa de impedimento físico.

examples.text: Es inútil seguir por este camino, así jamás lograremos el objetivo.
